title: Has GPT-6-Astra Achieved Embodied Intelligence?
task: Evaluating embodied intelligence of GPT-6-Astra across robotic manipulation and navigation
key_results: GPT-6-Astra shows strong performance on manipulation and navigation benchmarks; real-world deployment reveals gaps in ICL demonstration collection and execution time constraints
comments: The distinction between embodied competence and practical embodied intelligence is insightful, though the paper relies on proprietary model evaluation without ablation details.

hypotheses.hypothesis: GPT-6-Astra has crossed the threshold of embodied competence
hypotheses.result: Largely true, but practical embodied intelligence still unachieved due to ICL data scarcity and real-world constraints

title: BizBench: Unveiling Hidden Challenges in Deploying Long-Horizon Agents for Real-World Business
task: Evaluating long-horizon agents on real-world business procedures with intermediate constraint validation
key_results: Claude Opus 5 achieves 64.0% strict success, GPT-6 Sol 61.3%; DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash uses ~70% more tool calls than reference executions
comments: The benchmark's emphasis on execution validity rather than outcome alone is valuable, though the gap between goal attainment and strict success suggests agents still struggle with constraint reasoning.

model_io.model: Claude Opus 5 / GPT-6 Sol / Qwen3.8-27B / DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash

hypotheses.hypothesis: Frontier models will achieve high strict success rates on business tasks with constraints
hypotheses.result: Failed; only 64% for Claude Opus 5, demonstrating execution overhead and invalid intermediate states

title: Learning to Think and Explore in 3D World
task: Training vision-language models to actively explore 3D environments via reinforcement learning
key_results: ACT3D achieves 53.2% accuracy (22.0% improvement over Qwen base), surpasses Gemini 3.6 Flash while using 50-70% fewer frames; exploration gains highest on questions requiring extensive navigation (16.3% improvement)
comments: The approach elegantly shows that RL-driven exploration emerges without explicit supervision, though generalization to unseen domains remains modest at 5.9% average improvement.

model_io.model: ACT3D (Qwen-based VLM with learned exploration policy)

hypotheses.hypothesis: VLMs can learn adaptive exploration policies solely from final-answer correctness rewards
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; RL enables question-conditioned exploration without viewpoint supervision

hypotheses.hypothesis: Exploration benefits correlate with question difficulty
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; gains increase from 0.6% for immediately answerable questions to 16.3% for occluded-target questions

title: HexaShell: A Thin Harness for Exploring the Limits of VLM Agents as Robot Coding Agents
task: Robot manipulation via coding agents with minimal harness and visual triangulation
key_results: HexaShell achieves 39.7% success and 48.0% progress on RoboDojo; pushing tasks reach 92.5% but tight insertion only 8.3%
comments: The thin-harness approach is pragmatic, but the strong contact-sensitivity bottleneck suggests visual reasoning alone is insufficient for precise manipulation.

model_io.model: GPT-6-Astra with Codex at medium reasoning

hypotheses.hypothesis: Coding agents can achieve SOTA on RoboDojo through visual triangulation and learned tools
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed; 39.7% success achieved, but contact sensitivity limits tight manipulation

title: Into the Unknown: Benchmarking AI agents on open scientific research problems
task: Evaluating AI agents on open scientific research follow-up paper generation
key_results: None of 135 submissions from nine frontier agents satisfy all domain conditions; 114 fail integrity checks for fabricated claims or contradictory numbers
comments: The benchmark's use of domain scientist-verified criteria is rigorous, but the severity of failure (84.4% integrity failure rate) raises concerns about current agent reliability for research.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Frontier agents can produce valid follow-up papers meeting domain-scientist conditions
hypotheses.result: Failed; 0% full success, 84.4% integrity failure rate across all agents

title: LiveMACE: Process-Aware Evaluation of LLM Agent Capabilities in Evolving Markets
task: Process-aware evaluation of LLM agents in evolving financial markets with mechanism-specific diagnostics
key_results: Pronounced outcome-capability gap observed; similar outcomes arise from markedly different mechanism-use patterns; realized returns often diverge from capability-specific measurements
comments: Using live markets as a testbed is innovative for studying agent behavior in naturally evolving environments, though the causality between trace-level patterns and outcomes remains complex.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Outcome-based metrics fully capture agent capability in evolving markets
hypotheses.result: Rejected; outcome-capability gap revealed via mechanism-specific diagnostics

title: Pack Light, CarryOn: Building Object-Oriented Context for Long-Horizon Agents
task: Organizing long-horizon agent context around reusable task objects rather than interaction history
key_results: CarryOn achieves 5.8% and 7.0% gains on OSWorld 2.0 and BrowseComp-Plus respectively; reduces total token usage by 51.9% and 22.9%
comments: The object-oriented context approach is clever for managing growing histories, though the mechanism for maintaining carrier validity across folds could benefit from clearer exposition.

model_io.model: Long-horizon agent with CarryOn context runtime

hypotheses.hypothesis: Reusable task objects enable better continuation than compressed histories
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 5.8-7.0% gains with 22.9-51.9% token reduction

title: Speculative Sampling in Interactive Video Generation
task: Interactive video generation with reduced latency via speculative sampling with noise padding
key_results: Speculative sampling combines large bidirectional windows with small-chunk interaction latency; removes waiting-time lower bound imposed by chunk boundaries
comments: The noise-padding strategy is elegant for bridging latency and quality, though empirical latency and FID numbers are absent from the abstract.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Larger bidirectional windows improve quality while maintaining low latency via noise padding
hypotheses.result: Supported conceptually; waiting-time lower bound removed

title: Scene-Designer: Learning Design Intelligence for Agentic 3D Scene Generation
task: Generating coherent 3D indoor scenes from natural language through design and critique learning
key_results: Scene-Designer achieves superior performance in physical validity, functional correctness, and layout coherence; critic guidance improves generation beyond training
comments: The complementary design-critique framework is sound, though quantitative metrics for scene quality are not reported in the abstract.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Critic-guided GRPO improves design decisions and reduces trial-and-error
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; test-time critic guidance improves scene generation

title: OpenMobile-2: Building Versatile Mobile Agents with Scalable Environments and App-Native Tools
task: Building versatile mobile agents with scalable training environments and hybrid GUI-tool use
key_results: OpenMobile-2 achieves 79.9% on AndroidWorld and 50.4% on MobileWorld; transfers to real devices with 59.6% on SPA-Bench (up from 31.9%)
comments: The scale of open training data (12K trajectories, 2K RL tasks) and MobileGym++ with 110+ apps is substantial, though domain-specific tool design may limit generalization.

model_io.model: OpenMobile-2 agent with hybrid GUI-tool interface

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid GUI-tool use improves performance on commercial mobile scenarios
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; strong transfer to real devices with 59.6% SPA-Bench performance

title: BridgeWAM: Bridging Video and Action Experts via Latent Bridge Queries
task: Decoupling video and action experts via latent bridge queries for efficient world action models
key_results: BridgeWAM achieves 98.25% on LIBERO and 72.24% on LIBERO-Plus with 5.06B parameters; reduces inference latency to 77.1ms (2.47x speedup vs Fast-WAM)
comments: The Bridge-of-Experts architecture elegantly decouples expert depths, though the 30-layer video expert to 2-layer action expert ratio suggests potential overparameterization in the vision component.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Joint video-action supervision guides visual representations toward action-relevant features
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; decoupled experts achieve 98.25% LIBERO success with 28.72% FLOP reduction

title: From Research Goals to Scientific Closure: Evaluating Agents Through Evidence-Supported Physics Research
task: Evaluating AI agents on expert-verified physics research tasks with evidence-supported closure criteria
key_results: Claude-Opus-5 achieves highest mean Atomic Score (6.29/10) but reaches RC4 (full closure) in only 32.7% of attempts; 36.2% of attempts scoring 8/10+ fail to achieve closure
comments: The distinction between local scientific accomplishment and research closure is crucial; the benchmark reveals that high scores do not guarantee meaningful scientific progress.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Frontier LLMs achieve complete research closure on physics tasks

title: Lexical Reference Frames: Interpreting LM Residual Streams in Native Semantics
task: Interpreting LM residual streams via native lexical reference frames without fixed lenses
key_results: Lexical reference frames (LexFrame[1]) reach 0.97 coherence vs 0.30-0.35 for fixed lenses; read states within 0.16 nats of model output; enable early exit skipping 0.45-0.42 of layers
comments: The native semantics interpretation via lexical frames is principled and interpretable; claims about attribution faithfulness exceed standard patching but lack detailed comparison.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Native reference frames capture model semantics better than fixed-lens approaches
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; LexFrame[1] reaches 0.97 coherence with faithful attribution

title: Tree-Aware Posterior Distillation for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
task: Long-horizon agentic RL with tree-aware credit assignment and bounded policy updates
key_results: TreeOPSD improves Qwen3-30B accuracy by 4.97 points over GRPO on Deep Research; no critic needed, recovers policy-gradient direction without value network
comments: The tree-structured credit assignment is theoretically motivated, though the improvement magnitude is modest and evaluation is limited to specific benchmarks.

model_io.model: TreeOPSD framework with frozen behavior policy

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tree-aware posterior distillation enables better credit assignment without learned critics

title: Xiaomi-Lens-0 Technical Report
task: Fine-grained region understanding in multimodal LLMs via interleaved mask prediction and reasoning
key_results: Xiaomi-Lens-0 gains 5.6 points average on RefCOCO/RefCOCO+/RefCOCOg over Qwen3.5; highest segmentation cIoU among compared models; surpasses Qwen3.5 on all perception benchmarks
comments: The lightweight mask decoder leveraging vision patches and language model latents is efficient; grounded reasoning via mask supervision is a clean way to teach spatial understanding.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Mask supervision from language-model latents improves fine-grained region understanding

title: RAP: A Dataset for Paper-to-Poster Generation via Declarative Markup from Human-Crafted Exemplars
task: Paper-to-poster generation via visual coding with verifiable HTML/CSS markup from exemplars
key_results: RAP dataset contains 25K+ verified paper-poster pairs with automated derendering to HTML/CSS; PosterRAG (training-free) and SFT+RL models both enable objective render-and-compare evaluation
comments: The fully automated derendering pipeline enabling objective evaluation is a significant contribution; the scale (25K pairs) supports both inference and training.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Exemplar-based retrieval and refilling enables automated poster generation without training
hypotheses.result: Supported; PosterRAG pipeline demonstrated as training-free alternative

title: Execution Before Memory: Diagnosing Memory Failures in Video World Models
task: Diagnosing memory failures in video world models via separated execution and memory tests
key_results: MIST reveals models set scenes but fail to carry out instructed changes; M3-Agent recovers by recursively revising instructions, improving WRBench T by 26.1% and MBench-T U by 52.7%
comments: The diagnostic separation of execution from memory is insightful; M3-Agent's recursive revision is simple but effective for addressing frozen-model limitations.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Execution bottleneck, not memory, explains video model failures
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; M3-Agent achieves 26.1-52.7% gains by fixing execution

title: DLite: History-free Speculative Decoding for Agentic AI
task: History-free speculative decoding for agentic LLM inference with evolving contexts
key_results: DLite achieves 2-6× acceptance length over baseline; outperforms DSpark by up to 70%; no historical KV cache overhead while handling long evolving contexts
comments: The history-free design addresses a real bottleneck in agentic workloads; the lightweight sequential head restoring causal dependencies is elegant, though training complexity is introduced.

model_io.model: DLite draft model with local sequential head

hypotheses.hypothesis: Growing historical context degrades draft model acceptance in agentic workloads
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 80% degradation observed; DLite fixes via local prediction

title: OfficeTown: Generative Organizations for Evolving Agent Intelligence

key_results: OfficeTown Bench contains 406 tasks with 4,836 criteria from 23 organizations; SFT+OPD on OfficeTown improves Qwen3.5-9B on external benchmarks including GDPval
comments: The organizational simulation framework is creative for generating realistic work contexts; principal-assistant harness outperforms single/multi-agent baselines, suggesting hierarchical coordination benefits.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Principal-assistant harness improves professional task completion over single-agent

title: MOSS-Image Technical Report

key_results: MOSS-Image achieves 96.3% text coverage on LongLongTextBench; ranks second on RealLayoutArena end-to-end comparison while ranking first with shared enhanced prompts
comments: The agentic prompt enhancement module is a practical addition; open-weight model achieving near-closed-source quality is valuable for the community.

key_results: Direct but uneven transfer observed across seven knowledge categories; textual and interleaved alignment improve knowledge access; substantial gaps remain between generation and answering
comments: Knowledge Transfer Probing methodology is rigorous; the finding that visual correctness does not guarantee text accessibility is important for multimodal training design.

model_io.model: Unified multimodal model with image generation

title: DiscoveryRSI: Recursively Learning to Discover Valuable Hypotheses

key_results: DiscoveryRSI-27B improves hypothesis quality from 4.86 to 5.39 over two rounds; achieves 6.3% hypothesis-publication correspondence (vs 2.5% GPT-6 Luna, 2.3% Claude Opus 5)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-agent evolutionary search develops higher-quality hypotheses than base LLM

title: Belief-Trajectory Energy: Measuring the Path to a Prediction

key_results: Scalar BTE provides model-relative difficulty signal; structured BTE supports human-LLM review detection (0.998 macro-AUROC) and generator attribution (95.6% eight-way accuracy)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Layerwise predictive revision characterizes input difficulty and reasoning patterns

title: Stuck on Shuffle: On Attribute-Object Binding in Vision-Language Models

key_results: SABER benchmark reveals substantial binding failures in CLIP and MLLM embedders; synthetic text-only finetuning improves binding while preserving general performance; SOTA on SABER and negation benchmarks
comments: Synthetic text supervision for binding is pragmatic; the finding that binding improves transfer broadly (negation, instance retrieval) justifies binding-focused training.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Synthetic binding text improves attribute-object binding without image supervision
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; gains transfer to cross-modal and image-image retrieval

title: SciΠvot: Benchmarking Principal-Investigator Judgment at Pivotal Moments of Scientific AutoResearch Agents

key_results: Claude Opus 5 and GPT-6 achieve 63.5% at medium reasoning (below human fresh-researcher 73.4%); models perform below chance on selected cases; project record access degrades performance

hypotheses.hypothesis: Frontier LLMs match human scientific judgment with project context access

key_results: OPMD achieves highest average accuracy on all three teacher-student settings; mechanism supervision yields more effective reasoning and alters solution strategies
comments: Mechanism-level supervision via student-compatible teacher representations is theoretically motivated; the improvement breadth (all settings) suggests broad applicability.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Mechanism-level supervision improves distillation over output-only supervision

hypotheses.hypothesis: Prelude-recurrent-coda architecture improves context extraction and reasoning

key_results: DuoDiscover doubles human-expert speedup on SWE-fficiency; achieves 1.92× speedup on vLLM, 1.38× on SQLite, 1.65× on CPU microarchitecture (vs ArchAgent v2 in 16.7 vs 40+ days)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Event-centric evaluation captures audio-video consistency better than global metrics

title: Dysregulated thymus-ovary axis promotes virtual memory T cell polarization to aggravate PMOS pathology
task: Identify how androgen-driven thymic remodeling promotes virtual memory CD8+ T cells that sustain ovarian inflammation in polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome
key_results: Androgen receptor signaling in thymic stromal cells causes early thymic involution; CD8+ (not CD4+) T cells are required for PMOS manifestation; virtual memory CD8+ T cells (TVM) preferentially expand in patients and models, accumulate in reproductive tissues, and persist after androgen withdrawal; JAK inhibition restricts TVM differentiation and ameliorates PMOS pathology
comments: Identification of TVM cells as persistent drivers of ovarian inflammation provides mechanistic insight into why PMOS persists despite androgen withdrawal, though the initial TVM cell priming event in the thymus remains unclear.

title: Miro1 mediates skeletal muscle insulin resistance in type 2 diabetes

key_results: Miro1 accumulates in skeletal muscle of obese and T2D patients and mouse models; accumulation is due to inadequate insulin-mediated AKT-Miro1 interaction; exercise training reduces Miro1 accumulation and improves insulin sensitivity; muscle-specific Miro1 deletion improves oxidative capacity and insulin sensitivity
comments: Clear clinical-to-mechanistic evidence linking mitochondrial dynamics to insulin resistance, though whether Miro1 is a therapeutic target or a biomarker of underlying dysfunction requires further investigation.

model_io.model: Patients with obesity and T2D (cross-sectional and RCT studies)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Inadequate insulin-mediated AKT-Miro1 interaction causes Miro1 accumulation, leading to impaired mitochondrial dynamics and insulin resistance in T2D

title: Nuclear adaptation to intracellular mechanical forces regulates the phagocytic capacity of Drosophila macrophages in vivo

model_io.model: Drosophila embryonic macrophages (in vivo live imaging)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Phagosome-induced nuclear strain triggers Lamin B upregulation and LINC complex function to sustain phagocytic capacity

title: OSW-1 impairs autophagic flux via AMPK/mTORC1/TFEB-dependent TFEB activation and STX17 downregulation, leading to necroptosis in colorectal cancer

comments: Well-characterized dual-pathway mechanism exploiting autophagy activation paradoxically coupled with flux impairment to drive necroptosis, though the biological advantage over apoptosis induction is not discussed.
